alleleFrequency.interpretation: Population frequency shows how common the variant is. It does not show the effect of the variant.

cadd.interpretation: CADD is rank-scaled. Its published clinical calibration applies only to missense variants and is not the primary AnnoCAT missense interpretation.

conservation.interpretation: Conservation gives supporting context. AnnoCAT uses general phyloP ranges when no calibration applies. FAVOR conservation aPC uses documented PHRED ranks. AnnoCAT does not combine missense calibration with REVEL.

quality.interpretation: Without a versioned assay- and caller-specific profile, quality values are context rather than inferred pass or failure states.
